caption:
Toto plays football and futsal every weekend. The day after, the calves and hamstrings feel tight.

Remedial massage can help tight muscles feel easier after a game. It works alongside warm-ups, cool-downs and strength work, not instead of them.

Hybi's cool-down: 5 minutes of easy jogging or walking, calf and hamstring stretches for 30 seconds × 2 each side, then water and a good sleep. Stop if you feel a sharp pain or start to limp.

A pop with sudden pain, swelling or bruising, or no change after two weeks is worth an assessment. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
